text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here! This year's spring<n>Tenno Sho will
begin shortly here at<n>the verdant grounds of Kyoto
Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The racer to look out for is, of course,<n>Mejiro
Bright, who has been making<n>her formidable
presence felt on the<n>track!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But will she be able to seize a<n>consecutive win
despite the fact that<n>she'll have to run against her
peer,<n>Mejiro Dober?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, I'm fine... It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Clearly, it's not nothing...<n>Something's been on her
mind since<n>the Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I know the race is about to<n>start, but don't
worry, I'll get my<n>head back on straight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (She only has eyes for the race!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That just gave me chills... She's so<n>determined...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (She's putting everything on the line<n>for this race!)
